title: KV slot priority scheduler: correctness for prefix-aware LRU/TTL hybrid
creator: Aisha N'Goma
description: Problem: Continuous batching increases memory pressure on GPU-resident KV cache. Current heuristics mix LRU and TTL but exhibit edge cases where prefix-scoped requests observe stale or missing KV frames after concurrent demotion/prefetch cycles. Goal: implement a deterministic slot-priority scheduler that enforces a correctness contract across LRU/TTL/prefix policies while preserving batching throughput and minimizing extra host<->device roundtrips. The scheduler must: (1) never drop a live prefix entry referenced by an in-flight request, (2) prefer evicting cold slots while keeping eviction cost bounded, and (3) produce auditable transitions (promote/demote/evict) to aid postmortems and telemetry. This ticket covers design, formal invariants, unit/integration tests, and a staged rollout plan.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Scheduler implements deterministic tie-breaking between LRU frequency and TTL age for slot selection. 2) Unit tests cover concurrent prefetch + eviction interleavings; no test should show a missed prefix for an acknowledged response. 3) Integration perf tests show <5% throughput regression under representative batch mixes and <=8% increase in p95 latency. 4) Telemetry emits transition traces and a compact audit log (slot_id, reason, caller_prefix, timestamp) for every demotion/eviction. 5) Canary rollout completed and rollback instrumentation validated.
design_notes: High level approach: introduce a small fixed-size priority vector per shard on the host that ranks slots by a composite score: score = alpha * normalized_lru + beta * normalized_ttl_rank + gamma * prefix_affinity_penalty. Key ideas: - Prefix affinity penalty: prevent eviction of slots that belong to prefixes with active inflight batches; implemented by keeping an inflight_counter per prefix and adding a large penalty while counter>0. - Deterministic tie-break: incorporate slot_id hash to avoid nondeterministic selection across threads. - Bounded eviction cost: prefer slots with zero prefetch_backpressure (i.e., no pending GPU streaming) and with smallest projected refill cost. - Auditability: emit a single-line JSON-like audit message per transition to the observability pipeline (compact to avoid cardinality explosion). Formal invariants: INV-1 (no-live-drop): if inflight_counter(prefix)>0 then scheduler will not evict slot for that prefix. INV-2 (progress): scheduler guarantees eventual reclamation of stale slots (ttl > configured_horizon) even if inflight counters flicker. INV-3 (deterministic): given identical shard state and event ordering, slot selection is deterministic. Implementation notes: host-side priority vector kept lock-free with epoched updates; eviction decision made on the host before RPC to device to avoid races with GPU slab compaction.
test_plan: Unit tests: simulate concurrent threads performing prefetch, acknowledge, and eviction; fuzzed interleavings using the existing eviction-sandbox harness (ENG-91827). Integration: run the batch-mix perf suite with synthetic and replay workloads (chat-heavy vs embed-heavy) and compare to baseline. Correctness fuzzing: run stress bench that replays production prefix churn traces with randomized TTLs for 24h. Canary: deploy shard-local scheduler to 5% of serving fleet, collect audit logs and compare to control to detect missed-reads. Metrics to collect: eviction_rate, re-refill_rate (refills within 200ms), p95 latency, false_miss_rate (application observed a miss that would have been a hit under strong consistency), and audit_event_size. Linked tests: PRs will include deterministic seed for fuzz runs and a set of golden logs for offline verification.
rollout_plan: 1) Feature-flagged merge behind runtime-1.20 flag. 2) Internal dogfood on staging with synthetic high-churn traces. 3) Canary to 5% production shards for 48h, monitor re-refill_rate and false_miss_rate. 4) Expand to 25% with additional telemetry-derived thresholds; if metrics stable, full rollout. 5) If we detect >0.1% increase in false_miss_rate or >10% throughput regression, automated rollback via flag. Rollback instrumentation: snapshot last-3000 audit events before toggling flag for forensic analysis.
blockers: - Need updated auditing pipeline to accept compact slot transition messages (SRE ticket pending). - Small risk: host-side lock-free priority vector requires additional review from runtime infra team. - Dependency on ENG-314159 for baseline refill cost estimator; until merged estimator will be a heuristic.
